aksum--aksum-maduro.description: Foundation Cigar Co. introduced this blend in 2023 as Metapa and renamed it Aksum, after the ancient Aksumite kingdom, in early 2024. The Maduro dresses a Connecticut Broadleaf binder and Nicaraguan Jalapa and Estelí filler in a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper, rolled at A.J. Fernandez. Chocolate is the thread, with espresso, cedar, leather and pepper.

thirds.notes: Cedar, pepper and leather, with powdery chocolate and a chili-flake heat that is strongest early on.
Bittersweet chocolate leads with black coffee, wood and earth, a creamy undertone and a flash of lime zest as the spice calms.
Little new appears: chocolate, wood and leather carry on, with a mineral note lingering at the end.

aksum--aksum-claro.description: Aksum, introduced by Foundation Cigar Co. in 2023 and named for the Aksumite kingdom, pairs a Connecticut Broadleaf binder with Nicaraguan long filler; the Claro takes a lighter Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper and is rolled at A.J. Fernandez. Spicy and bready, it moves through nuts, leather and earth toward cocoa, coffee and a coconut-like sweetness.

thirds.notes: Bold spice with cinnamon and pepper over nuts, leather and earth, plus a toasty, grainy note.
Creamy bread and oak soften the spice; dark chocolate and dried fruit show on the retrohale.
Buttered toast, pepper and wood, finishing on coffee bean and cashew with earth and leather lingering.
